ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ ۝١
ayahs.translation: He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away
ayahs.translationClear: He frowned and turned away.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ ۝٢
ayahs.translation: Because there came to him the blind man,[1853] [interrupting].

footnotes.1853: ʿAbdullāh, the son of Umm Maktūm.

ayahs.translationClear: When the blind man approached him.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ ۝٣
ayahs.translation: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified[1854]

footnotes.1854: As a result of what he learns from you.

ayahs.translationClear: But how do you know? Perhaps he was seeking to purify himself.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ ۝٤
ayahs.translation: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
ayahs.translationClear: Or be reminded, and the message would benefit him.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ ۝٥
ayahs.translation: As for he who thinks himself without need,[1855]

footnotes.1855: i.e., without need of faith or need of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) . Here it is in reference to a certain influential member of the Quraysh whom the Prophet (ﷺ) had hoped to bring to Islām.

ayahs.translationClear: But as for him who was indifferent.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ ۝٦
ayahs.translation: To him you give attention.
ayahs.translationClear: You gave him your attention.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ ۝٧
ayahs.translation: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.[1856]

footnotes.1856: The Prophet (ﷺ) was responsible only for conveying the message, not for ultimate guidance.

ayahs.translationClear: Though you are not liable if he does not purify himself.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ ۝٨
ayahs.translation: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
ayahs.translationClear: But as for him who came to you seeking.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ ۝٩
ayahs.translation: While he fears [Allāh],
ayahs.translationClear: In awe.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ ۝١٠
ayahs.translation: From him you are distracted.
ayahs.translationClear: To him you were inattentive.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ ۝١١
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, they [i.e., these verses] are a reminder;
ayahs.translationClear: Do not. This is a lesson.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ ۝١٢
ayahs.translation: So whoever wills may remember it.[1857]

footnotes.1857: The revelation. Or "Him," i.e., Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) .

ayahs.translationClear: Whoever wills, shall remember it.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ ۝١٣
ayahs.translation: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,
ayahs.translationClear: On honorable pages.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ ۝١٤
ayahs.translation: Exalted and purified,
ayahs.translationClear: Exalted and purified.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍ ۝١٥
ayahs.translation: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
ayahs.translationClear: By the hands of scribes.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍ ۝١٦
ayahs.translation: Noble and dutiful.
ayahs.translationClear: Noble and devoted.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ ۝١٧
ayahs.translation: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] is man;[1858] how disbelieving is he.

footnotes.1858: i.e., those who deny Allāh's message.

ayahs.translationClear: Perish man! How thankless he is!

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ ۝١٨
ayahs.translation: From what thing [i.e., substance] did He create him?
ayahs.translationClear: From what did He create him?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ ۝١٩
ayahs.translation: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;[1859]

footnotes.1859: His proportions, provisions, life span, etc.

ayahs.translationClear: From a sperm drop He created him, and enabled him.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ ۝٢٠
ayahs.translation: Then He eased the way for him;[1860]

footnotes.1860: Into this world (i.e., his birth) . It may also refer to life itself, which has been made easier by Allāh's guidance.

ayahs.translationClear: Then He eased the way for him.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ ۝٢١

words.translation: and provides a grave for him

ayahs.translation: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.[1861]
ayahs.translationClear: Then He puts him to death, and buries him.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ ۝٢٢
ayahs.translation: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
ayahs.translationClear: Then, when He wills, He will resurrect him.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ ۝٢٣
ayahs.translation: No! He [i.e., man] has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
ayahs.translationClear: But no, he did not fulfill what He has commanded him.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ ۝٢٤
ayahs.translation: Then let mankind look at his food -
ayahs.translationClear: Let man consider his food.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّا ۝٢٥
ayahs.translation: How We poured down water in torrents,
ayahs.translationClear: We pour down water in abundance.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّا ۝٢٦
ayahs.translation: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
ayahs.translationClear: Then crack the soil open.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا ۝٢٧
ayahs.translation: And caused to grow within it grain
ayahs.translationClear: And grow in it grains.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا ۝٢٨
ayahs.translation: And grapes and herbage
ayahs.translationClear: And grapes and herbs.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا ۝٢٩
ayahs.translation: And olive and palm trees
ayahs.translationClear: And olives and dates.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًا ۝٣٠
ayahs.translation: And gardens of dense shrubbery
ayahs.translationClear: And luscious gardens.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَفَـٰكِهَةً وَأَبًّا ۝٣١
ayahs.translation: And fruit and grass -
ayahs.translationClear: And fruits and vegetables.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَّتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ ۝٣٢
ayahs.translation: [As] enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.
ayahs.translationClear: Enjoyment for you, and for your livestock.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ ۝٣٣
ayahs.translation: But when there comes the Deafening Blast[1862]

footnotes.1862: The piercing blast of the Horn which signals resurrection. Aṣ-Ṣākhkhah is also a name for the Day of Resurrection.

ayahs.translationClear: But when the Deafening Noise comes to pass.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ ۝٣٤
ayahs.translation: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
ayahs.translationClear: The Day when a person will flee from his brother.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ ۝٣٥
ayahs.translation: And his mother and his father
ayahs.translationClear: And his mother and his father.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ ۝٣٦
ayahs.translation: And his wife and his children,
ayahs.translationClear: And his consort and his children.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: لِكُلِّ امْرِي͏ٔ͏ٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ شَاْنٌ يُّغْنِيْهِ ؕ
ayahs.translation: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.[1863]

footnotes.1863: i.e., to occupy him. He will be concerned only with himself, thus forgetting all others.

ayahs.translationClear: Every one of them, on that Day, will have enough to preoccupy him.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ ۝٣٨
ayahs.translation: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
ayahs.translationClear: Faces on that Day will be radiant.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ ۝٣٩
ayahs.translation: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
ayahs.translationClear: Laughing and rejoicing.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ ۝٤٠
ayahs.translation: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
ayahs.translationClear: And faces on that Day will be covered with misery.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ ۝٤١
ayahs.translation: Blackness will cover them.
ayahs.translationClear: Overwhelmed by remorse.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ ۝٤٢
ayahs.translation: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
ayahs.translationClear: These are the faithless, the vicious.
